changes.text: The required asterisk (`.req`) is spaced with `margin-inline-start` instead of `margin-left`, so the gap sits on the correct side under `dir="rtl"`.
The invalid focus ring is derived from the `--ss-danger` palette slot with `color-mix()` (was `rgba(var(--ss-red-rgb), 0.22)`), so it follows a custom palette.

New component: a styled native `<input type="date">` on the shared field chrome, with a bindable ISO `value`, `min` / `max`, `label`, `hint` / `error` wiring, `required`, `disabled`, `readonly`, `invalid` and `size`.
